analysis.title: Global Payments Inc. (GPN): 3Q26 First Take: Relatively in-line quarter
key_insights: GPN reported 3Q26 results roughly in line with consensus on nearly all metrics. GS expects the print to be uncontroversial.
GPN continues to track to more than 4% organic revenue growth and raised targeted Worldpay synergies to $650mn.
SMB revenue grew about 3% in the quarter, which GS calls a bit soft. Platforms and Enterprise each grew 8% revenue on double-digit volume growth.
With results in line, GS expects the call to focus on strategy and the broader strategic alternatives discussion.
GS call topics: color on top lien growth expectations into 2027, strategic alternatives, recent travel trends, and the Genius roll out and enhancements.

Management reiterated its 2026 outlook: constant currency ex-disposition revenue growth of 4-5%, which implies reported adjusted net revenue growth of about 2.5% after 2% of dispositions (Street about 2.7%). Adjusted EPS guidance is $13.60-$13.80.
Management expects 150bps of operating margin expansion in 2026 and expects FCF adjustments to decline into 2027 as the transformation concludes.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Neutral with a $98 12-month PT, based on a 5x P/E multiple on Q5-Q8 estimates. The stock closed at $96.09 on 4 Nov 2026, implying 2.0% upside.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted revenue reported ~$3.18bn vs Visible Alpha consensus est ~$3.18bn, in line. GS est was $3,181mn.
3Q26 adjusted operating income reported $1.35bn (42.5% margin), in line with consensus est of $1,351mn.
3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $3.58 vs Street consensus est $3.57 and GS est $3.56. Reported 3Q25 EPS was $3.26 and 2Q26 was $3.46.
3Q26 adjusted FCF reported $870mn, 92% conversion of adjusted net income. This compares with GS est $1,131mn and consensus est $794mn.
Segment revenue reported: Enterprise $836mn (+8% y/y), Platforms $625mn (+8% y/y), SMB $1,548mn (flat y/y, about 0% per Exhibit 1), Other $173mn (-18% y/y). GS describes SMB growth as 3% in the text.

FY26 guidance reiterated: adjusted EPS $13.60-$13.80 (midpoint $13.70 vs consensus est $13.64). Adjusted net revenue guidance midpoint about $12.4bn, growth about 2.5% vs consensus est about 2.2% in the exhibit.
Implied 4Q26 guide: adjusted EPS $3.60-$3.80 (mid $3.70 vs consensus est $3.66).
Other FY26 guidance items: about $880mn net interest and other expense, about 15% adjusted tax rate, $70mn EII, -$90mn net income to NCI, about $1bn capex, about 90% FCF conversion.
risk_factors: Upside risks named by GS: better than expected macro, better roll out of new products and services, and an improving competitive environment.
Downside risks named by GS: a worsening competitive environment, unfavorable regulation, and a less favorable macro environment.
